title: Warm Monsoon Green Olives Tagine
description: A flavorful, aerated stew originating from Egypt, characterized by its use of green olives and earthenware cooking. This dish is suitable for Dash-friendly cooking and perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook over low heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chopped cilantro, grated ginger, salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and turmeric. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced green olives and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add two tablespoons of lemon juice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove the ttukbaegi from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
